title: Compiled Python bytecode committed to the repo
detail: A .pyc build artifact is added as a tracked file while the .gitignore change covers only .pp-settings.bin. Bytecode will drift and rot with every interpreter.
recommended_fix: Delete the .pyc from the index and add __pycache__/ (or *.pyc) to .gitignore.

title: Derivation script contains no derivation search; helpers are dead code
evidence:
def scale_lum(rgb, target_l): ... def mix(a, b, t): ... def lum(rgb): ... # never called anywhere in the file
def verify(mode, remap, classes, tune=True): ... # tune unused
"""4. Where a pair collides, search the mode-space remap ... then numeric search."""
detail: Docstring, PR body, and spec all claim simulator-derived numeric search; derive() is entirely hand-set constant tuples. scale_lum/mix/lum and the tune parameter are never invoked.
recommended_fix: Either implement the documented collision search or delete the dead helpers and rewrite the docs to say hand-picked anchors verified by simulation.

title: Pairwise threshold class chosen by structural color equality on pr[0] only
detail: A signal token whose RGB(A) ever equals a map token silently gets the laxer 40 threshold; only pr[0] is inspected, so ordering of each append decides the gate.
recommended_fix: Carry the threshold with the pair explicitly (like the Python T_SIGNAL/T_MAP tuple) instead of inferring it from color equality.

title: CI gate 2 label says 'Core unit tests' but now runs app/render/audio/harness suites
evidence: "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test"
detail: The gate description no longer matches its content; failure reporting will attribute app/harness test breaks to 'core', misleading triage.
recommended_fix: Rename the gate (e.g. 'Unit tests: core + app + render + audio + harness (x3 app repeat)').

title: s_ownership scenario defines only mouse frames; touch/pad legs may be vacuous
detail: No touch or pad frames are supplied, yet check_states iterates all devs. If scenario_devices still yields three devices, the touch/pad legs assert nothing — the r1 vacuous-leg failure mode.
recommended_fix: Either supply intent-equivalent touch/pad scripts (e.g. lane-button tap / pad S-equivalent) or restrict this scenario's device list to mouse.

title: verify() tune parameter accepted but never used
evidence:
def verify(mode, remap, classes, tune=True):
    """Check every pair under the simulation on EFFECTIVE colors. Returns the
    (possibly empty) failure list — no silent auto-nudging: anchors are the
    canon; if a pair fails, HAND-TUNE the anchors above."""
detail: The parameter suggests a tuning mode that does not exist; every caller omits it. Dead surface on a claimed-derivation tool.
